offerings.name: Mineral-rights education and decision support
offerings.description: Free, no-pressure, plain-language education for owners comparing offers, inherited interests, royalties, production, and sell-or-hold decisions.

offerings.name: Secure owner intake
offerings.description: Situation-specific document and property-detail intake that helps an owner organize records for review.

offerings.name: Directional Senior Underwriter review
offerings.description: A directional assessment based on available public records, production data, owner-provided documents, and stated assumptions; it is not a certified appraisal or professional advice.

offerings.name: Disclosed acquisition transaction
offerings.description: MRX may offer to buy a mineral interest and may earn revenue as the disclosed buyer; transaction terms are provided in writing before an agreement.

audiences: Heirs and families organizing inherited mineral interests
Owners with declining or suspended royalty payments
Owners who want a no-pressure directional review before deciding whether to hold, lease, or sell

markets_and_locations.coverage: Nationwide online education, secure intake, and directional review
markets_and_locations.limits: Nationwide coverage does not establish a storefront, staffed local office, travel-based service area, Google Business Profile eligibility, or licensed local presence.

markets_and_locations.coverage: The live Brand Vault contains a Midland business-contact record
markets_and_locations.limits: Do not publish or synchronize LocalBusiness schema, map-pack claims, or an in-person service location unless operating facts and platform eligibility are separately verified.

positioning.summary: A careful, source-first educational guide for mineral and royalty owners that explains assumptions and limitations, avoids pressure and unsupported promises, and discloses when MRX may be the buyer.
differentiators: Free, no-pressure education and directional review
Plain-language explanation of sources, assumptions, uncertainty, and limits
Written disclosure before agreement when MRX may act as buyer
voice: Transparent about uncertainty, limitations, and commercial relationship

prohibited_claims_and_topics: Guaranteed value, guaranteed offer, guaranteed outcome, or a promise to beat an offer
Certified appraisal, certified appraiser, USPAP appraisal, formal appraisal, or MRX appraisal report
Individualized legal, tax, title, accounting, engineering, or investment advice
Named-underwriter marketing exposure or an AI-guide persona presented as a human, licensed professional, or approved author
Unsupported statistics, payout figures, customer counts, years-in-business, trusted-by language, credentials, results, testimonials, or social proof
Marketplace, broker, agent, neutral intermediary, or commission-only positioning unless newly supported and approved
Local storefront, service-area, Google Business Profile, or licensed-local-presence claims without separate eligibility evidence
Guaranteed rankings, indexing, answer-engine retrieval, citations, media placement, or model-training access
Fabricated consensus, entity relationships, reviews, citations, or schema

public_website: Keep the visible entity, metadata, canonical URLs, native schema, social metadata, sitemap, internal links, images, and machine-readable discovery surfaces consistent and source-backed.
Use ProfessionalService or Organization when supported; do not add Person or LocalBusiness schema without a separate source and review.
Treat generated optimization recommendations as proposals and reject unsupported FAQ, NLP, schema, geography, alt text, or claim changes.
articles: Finalize the canonical article title before asset generation.
Render that exact title into a unique hero image and use the same canonical asset for page hero, og:image, twitter:image, and CMS featured/share image.
Verify a separate, meaningful in-body image; the hero and inline image are independent release checks.
Use MRX Editorial Team as the approved organizational author; do not expose a named underwriter or attribute authorship to an AI-guide persona.
search_atlas_and_ai_generation: Use the brand pack as the source of truth and keep facts, assumptions, recommendations, approvals, deployments, verification, and outcomes distinct.
Disable unreviewed FAQ and generic image generation where the tool cannot enforce MRX claim and exact-title image gates.
Require current primary sources for material claims and preserve reviewed content identity.
Do not put private owner data or credentials into Brand Vault, prompts, reports, or artifacts.
ai_visibility_and_measurement: Use fixed, dated prompt sets and record denominator, engine, locale, device, date, and evidence for each observation.
Describe visibility, citations, indexing, and AI access as measured observations, not guaranteed outcomes.
Treat llms.txt and Markdown alternatives as optional discovery aids, not ranking or training guarantees.
authority_and_offsite: Use truthful attribution, disclosure, source identity, and destination-page relevance.
Do not fabricate independent consensus or imply a disclosed-buyer relationship is neutral third-party advice.
Any paid distribution or separately metered placement requires charge-specific owner approval before spend.
local: Nationwide digital coverage does not establish a physical local presence or Google Business Profile eligibility.
Keep GBP and LocalBusiness activation paused until staffed-location or eligible service-area facts are verified.
paid_media: Paid activation is outside this brand-pack run and remains paused until account readiness, conversion tracking, claim-safe creative, and a charge ceiling are approved.

competitor_status: No current competitor set was treated as fact; future competitive work must create a dated, source-backed market snapshot.

approval.basis: Standing MRX owner directives and the 2026-08-31 instruction to take brand action from the three latest Summit playbooks
